sentences.text: Edna Hollis (S2) stated she has a stiff hip in the mornings and uses a frame in the house.
Edna Hollis (S2) stated she does not go out without someone.
Edna Hollis (S2) stated carers visit in the morning and at teatime.
Edna Hollis (S2) stated the morning carer, Jade, is very good, does her tablets, and helps her wash.
Edna Hollis (S2) stated the teatime carers are sometimes quick, come in and out, but do her tea.
Edna Hollis (S2) stated her daughter, Sandra, shops on Saturdays when she can.
Edna Hollis (S2) stated Sandra lives in Castleford and it is a drive for her.
Edna Hollis (S2) stated her grandson, Kyle (23), pops in most weeks.
Edna Hollis (S2) stated Kyle brings her paper sometimes.
Edna Hollis (S2) stated Kyle goes to the cash machine for her because she cannot get to the post office.
Edna Hollis (S2) stated she does not want Kyle in trouble or the police involved.
Edna Hollis (S2) stated she wants her money to be her money.
Edna Hollis (S2) stated Sandra says Kyle gambles on his phone with betting things, but Edna has never seen him do it.
Edna Hollis (S2) stated Kyle has not threatened her or hurt her.
Edna Hollis (S2) stated she does not want the police involved as long as Kyle does not get arrested.
Edna Hollis (S2) stated Kyle has her bank card.
Edna Hollis (S2) stated she gave Kyle the bank card number because it is easier.
Edna Hollis (S2) stated Kyle takes her money out, keeps fifty pounds for himself every week, and she does not say anything.
Edna Hollis (S2) stated Kyle never asked for the money, just has it, and she sees it on the statement.
Edna Hollis (S2) stated she had £400 in her purse for Christmas presents, and Kyle took the money after he visited; it was gone after he had been there.
Edna Hollis (S2) stated the money incident happened three weeks ago (three weeks Sunday).
Edna Hollis (S2) stated Kyle has not paid the £400 back yet, but said he will.
Edna Hollis (S2) stated she does not put the heating on during the day now, only when someone is coming.
Edna Hollis (S2) stated she eats toast for dinner at the end of the month because there is nothing left.
Edna Hollis (S2) stated she does not get Attendance Allowance, only her pension.
Edna Hollis (S2) stated Sandra knows about the purse incident but was cross; she does not know about the bank card.
Edna Hollis (S2) stated she does not want the girls (carers) in trouble.
Edna Hollis (S2) stated she will ring the social worker on the number on the card or the duty line if Kyle asks for money before Thursday and she is worried.
